account: MEDIAIPLUS describes AI tools for protocol preparation and matching sponsors with research organizations. Early deployments reportedly reduced data-alignment time by 85% and outsourcing costs by 10%, while improving trial success by 25%. Blisstech is named as a validation partner. The submission does not give trial counts, comparison periods, or a patient benefit attributable to the tools. In December 2025 MEDIAIPLUS chief executive Jung Jihee told Fortune Korea that FiCRO cuts the time to select a research organization by about 87% and supplies 70% of company revenue. The company's savings figures vary across its statements, and no client or independent evaluator has published results.

evidence.quote: These combined efforts increased overall trial success rates by 25%, and reduced the time required to collect and align clinical trial data by 85%-directly supporting faster patient access to critical therapies.
